{{Quote|Manju is a spice trafficker and slaver, Khobisho is a negotiator and advocate for the Cartel, and Prodoranya runs an industrial moon.|Katha Niar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Khobisho''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] negotiator and advocate of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. He, [[Manju (Hutt)|Manju]], and [[Prodoranya]] were told by [[Archon]] [[Szajin]] that [[Solida Hesk]]'s place would be safe for them.
